description: Check any WEBSITE's AI visibility with a 7-criteria technical AEO audit: JSON-LD, llms.txt, AI bots in robots.txt and more. Use when you need to know if a site can be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity or Claude — returns a 0-7 score with exact fixes plus a generated llms.txt draft. This audits ONLY the website (no Google Business Profile data, no reviews): use local_presence_audit instead when you need the full local-business picture (GBP + reviews + website) with a /100 score and sales deliverables. FREE — no per-run charge. Auth: Apify API token required (Authorization: Bearer) even though the actor itself is free. Rate limit: 60 calls/min/IP on this facade; full report returned in one response, no pagination.

generateLlmsTxt.description: Also generate a ready-to-publish llms.txt draft for the audited site (delivered in the dataset and in the key-value store as llms.txt).
generateLlmsTxt.title: Generate llms.txt draft

url.description: Full URL of the site to audit (e.g. https://example.lu). The checker fetches the homepage, /llms.txt and /robots.txt.
url.title: Website URL

name: aeo_ai_visibility_checker
